### Fixed
- **A token-exchange server recovers on its own when its token endpoint answers again.** A caller's exchange that timed out, was refused or got a 5xx or a gateway's HTML page left the server `Failed` (reason `TokenExchangeEndpoint`) with no retry, so `MusterMCPServerFailed` kept paging until a user's session happened to exchange a token. Now the server is put on the reconnect backoff and each retry probes the token endpoint with the exchange's client credentials and a subject token no issuer signed: while the probe gets no answer the server stays `Failed` (never `Unreachable`), and the first OAuth answer returns it to `Awaiting Session`, with no caller involved. `invalid_client` and an unknown connector are still not retried. A `Failed` server's `Ready` message names the next attempt. ([#1368](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1368))
